verdicts.rationale: CONFIRMED: Parameter validation gap at /schema endpoint. The HNSW config validation function checks maxConnections (lines 262-267) and efConstruction (lines 276-281) but completely omits validation for the ef parameter. Live reproduction confirms system accepts ef=-1, ef=-999, and ef=0 with HTTP 200, returning schemas with invalid ef values set. Matches BS-004 pattern (Type1_IllegalSuccess) and developer blindspot: 'Input validation is often incomplete at API boundaries'. Historical precedent shows maintainers fix such 5xx status code issues for parameter validation defects (PRs 12049, 12040, 11878). The OptionalIntFromMap helper accepts any int64 without bounds checking. This is a true security-relevant defect enabling DoS via invalid HNSW index configuration.
